sonnet.q1: Keys are loaded first: load() runs before the HTTP server listens, and /healthz returns 200 (ready) only after load() has succeeded.
sonnet.q2: It retries 3 times, 2 seconds apart, then exits non-zero and never becomes ready. The rollout halts and old pods keep serving, so live traffic is unaffected.
sonnet.q3: Every 5 minutes refresh() reads the latest version and replaces the in-memory value (logging the new version id), with no restart. If the read fails, it keeps the last good value and logs a warning that never includes a key value.
sonnet.q4: Held only in process memory. They must never go to disk, environment variables or logs.
sonnet.q5: Read: the orders-api-prod service identity (the production pods) has read access to orders-api/prod/*; engineers cannot read prod values. Write: only the security on-call.
sonnet.q6: NOT STATED for why deletion alone is insufficient (the document only says the file is in git and copied into every image). Old values are made harmless by rotating at the providers and revoking the old keys in step 9 (after which pre-migration images' keys are revoked).
sonnet.q7: Each provider client calls get(name) on every request, which returns the in-memory value. A refreshed key is used by the next request with no restart.
sonnet.q8: Wait 10 minutes, list the pods (4 expected), and read /healthz on each. Every pod must show, for all three names, the version id that step 7 returned. If any pod is missing, unreachable or shows an old id, do not revoke.
sonnet.q9: 1) Set access, 2) store the current keys, 3) ship the reader (switch the app to read the store), 4) remove keys from the repo, then (5 rollback notes, 6 deploy and verify) 7) rotate at providers, 8) confirm every pod, 9) revoke old keys.
sonnet.q10: Local runs (make run) set APP_ENV=dev and read orders-api/dev/ in the store, which holds the sandbox keys. Whose credentials or how a developer authenticates is NOT STATED (open question).
sonnet.q11: NOT STATED. The document only covers store unreachable (retry then exit) and APP_ENV unset or unknown (refuses to start).
sonnet.q12: No. This plan sets no cadence; whether to rotate on a schedule is undecided by security.
